name: smwsprites-bouncing-spiny-egg
title: Bouncing Spiny Egg
description:
Bouncing Spiny Egg. Comes with cleaner code and slower movement to improve usability.

It bounces off slopes at predetermined angles based on steepness. Also bounces off walls and rides along the ceiling until it falls.

Now PIXI compatible.

(Rykon-V73)Small change: Added .json file and made the tilemap easier to edit.
